title: Local firm goes green
L: PORTVILLE — Lindqvist Printing, one of Portville's oldest businesses, has completed the installation of 600 solar panels on the roof of its factory.
The panels are expected to provide about 40 percent of the company's electricity.
"Our customers increasingly ask about the environmental impact of their orders," said owner Erik Lindqvist.
"This investment helps us answer that question and lowers our costs over time." The company also plans to switch to recycled paper for all standard orders by next spring.
Lindqvist Printing was founded in 1962 by Mr. Lindqvist's grandfather and now employs 85 people.
